blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. led the groundbreaking ceremony on Friday for a P2.2-billion bulk water supply project in Iloilo, which is expected to provide an additional 86 million liters per day (MLD) of water to the province. The Government-to-Government Bulk Water Supply Project, located at the Metro Iloilo Bulk Water Facility in Barangay Talanghauan, Sta. Barbara, will utilize 86 MLD of excess raw water from the Jalaur River Multi-Purpose Project Stage II to help meet the growing water needs of households in Iloilo.
